motivating_diagnostic: Across S16, S17, S17b and S18 — four different entry mechanisms tested with IDENTICAL execution — the average losing trade sits at approximately -0.95R regardless of entry quality, and 84% of S18's trades (118/140) closed via STOP. This means the vast majority of trades never reach the +1.0R activation threshold for breakeven+chandelier trailing at all: the risk-management mechanism almost never gets a chance to act. This protocol changes ONLY the activation threshold (and, in H2, the trail width), keeping S18's best entry (order block + open interest confirmation, route 'oi') completely unchanged, to isolate whether earlier activation converts some full losers into scratches/small winners without materially shrinking winners.

hypotheses.entry: identical to S18 H1 (order_block_oi_confirmation_scalp, route='oi'): regime (4h EMA200 trend+slope, 1h ADX>=20) + order-block structure (displacement>=1.5xATR, volume>=1.2x avg, first-touch trigger) + OBV flow confirmation + OI confirmation (non-negative/non-positive change over 8 bars in the trade direction)
hypotheses.exit: breakeven+chandelier trailing activated at +0.5R (was +1.0R in S16-S18); trail at best-price minus 1.5x ATR (unchanged); 5.0R hard cap; 240 minute time stop

breakeven+chandelier trailing activated at +0.5R, trail at best-price minus 1.0x ATR (tighter than H1's 1.5x — banks gains faster once activated, since activation now happens much earlier in a trade's life); 5.0R hard cap; 240 minute time stop

single_variable_isolated: Only partial_r (breakeven/trailing activation threshold) and, in H2, trail_atr change versus S18 H1. Entry signal generation, regime, structure, flow, OI confirmation, stop placement and position sizing are byte-for-byte identical to S18.

symbols.note: Reuses the exact same cached klines/funding/metrics archives already downloaded for S18 — no new data source.

promotion_gates.development_to_validation: PF >1.05, net PnL >0, at least 40 fills
promotion_gates.validation_to_retrospective_evaluation: base PF >1.10, stress PF >=1.00, at least 20 base fills, at least 2/3 symbols net positive, no symbol >60% gross profit
promotion_gates.paper_to_live: at least 200 prospective candidates across three full frozen months, PF >=1.25 base and >=1.10 stress, expectancy >=0.10R, 95% session-block bootstrap lower bound >0, max DD <=4%

execution.one_global_position: single global minute event loop with one shared cash balance, pending order and open position across the correlated ETH/SOL/BNB cluster
execution.ambiguous_bar: stop first; no favorable exit on limit fill minute

selection: Exactly H1 and H2. No parameter grid over the activation threshold (only 0.5 tested, chosen as half of S18's 1.0 — a natural, pre-declared halving, not swept) or trail width beyond these two named points. A failing gate stops that route; choose no least-bad winner.
stress_semantics: Stress and severe are deployability replays: higher costs and limit penetration are known before entry, so the reward/cost filter is reapplied and the fill cohort may shrink.
risk_acknowledged_before_running: Earlier breakeven activation could just as easily convert some CURRENT WINNERS into scratches (stopped at breakeven by ordinary noise before the move extends) as it could save losers — this is not assumed to help; it is measured.
known_limitations: Same order-block, OI, ATR-freeze and no-order-book-reconstruction simplifications as S18.
This is a retrospective diagnostic; not a live paper-forward result.
